name: Naviva, Four Seasons, Punta Mita
insider_take: Mexico's first adults-only Four Seasons resort sits on a pristine stretch of Riviera Nayarit coastline, where luxury tented suites blend seamlessly with the jungle canopy.
whats_special: Naviva features just 15 ultra-luxe tented accommodations elevated on stilts among ancient trees, each with private plunge pools and outdoor bathrooms. The property's unique "glamping meets luxury resort" concept offers an intimate connection to nature while maintaining Four Seasons' legendary service standards. The resort also provides exclusive access to two world-class golf courses designed by Jack Nicklaus.
pro_tip: Book the "Cuexcomate" tent for the most spectacular ocean views, and don't miss the property's signature mezcal tasting experience featuring rare varieties from across Mexico.
dont_miss: The transformative spa treatments in open-air pavilions, private yacht excursions to the hidden Marieta Islands (home to the famous "Hidden Beach"), and sunset horseback rides along the secluded beach. The nearby Islas Marietas are a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve perfect for snorkeling with manta rays and dolphins.
pros: Ultra-luxury tented villas with private outdoor living spaces
Immersive nature experience in protected coastal forest
Exceptional Four Seasons service and attention to detail
Exclusive access to pristine beaches and championship golf
